raw_response:
Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification (whiteout) of the left hemithorax. The mediastinal structures, including the trachea and heart, are shifted towards the right side (away from the opacity), which is characteristic of a space-occupying lesion like a massive pleural effusion or empyema, rather than lung collapse which would pull the mediastinum towards the affected side.
